_comment: The Temporal CLI pin (services/temporal/_install.py). Asset keys are <os>_<arch> in the CLI release's spellings. Bump the version, server_version and all checksums together from the official checksums.txt. A new server minor starts every install from an empty Temporal database: at the next start, a database the pinned server minor did not create is deleted with every older CLI file (RFC-0005 E16). A patch bump of the same minor keeps the database. dynamic_config is passed to start-dev on every boot (RFC-0006 T17): fairness on and one task-queue partition, and a run gets the TemporalReportedProblems search attribute after 5 failed workflow tasks in a row (the watchdog's stuck-runs count, 1b.38b). The marker records the partition values, and a database created with others starts from new, because partitions can be lowered safely only on a new database.
